name: Palace in a Pool
description: They say that long ago, seawater had yet to fill this pool. The moonlight was brighter back then, and it filled the pool instead, flowing freely like quicksilver.

tabs.name: Tutelage: Umigozen's Mansion
tabs.description: Once, in the ancient mansion of Umigozen, famed throughout Inazuma, there was a window that could be used to enjoy wine and observe the flowers outside. Now the mansion lies empty, and only bandits and thieves dwell within.
